requirements.title: Program-sheet year selection
requirements.summary: Use a program sheet from the matriculation year or later; requirements from different sheets cannot be mixed.

requirements.title: Letter-grade requirement and historical exceptions
requirements.summary: Program-sheet courses require letter grades except Spring 2019–20 and Autumn 2020–21 through Summer 2020–21.

requirements.title: No category double-counting
requirements.summary: A program-sheet course may count under only one category; separate CS degree rules identify Writing in the Major exceptions unrelated to AI depth.

requirements.title: Program-sheet approval
requirements.summary: Submit planned/completed courses with units for approval at least one quarter before expected graduation. Only approved sheets proceed to Engineering graduation review; special registration status also requires an approved sheet.

requirements.title: Track completion and changes
requirements.summary: The AI track belongs to the CS BS. Track changes are allowed, but one full CS track must be satisfied before applying to graduate; notify CS through its track-change form after the Axess request.

requirements.title: Exceptions and deviations
requirements.summary: Departures from the published program sheet require a petition for exceptions or deviations; approval is not assumed.

requirements.title: Combined CS program GPA
requirements.summary: The parent CS program requires at least 2.0 GPA across Engineering Fundamentals, CS Core, Depth and Senior Project combined; this is not a separately stated AI-track GPA.

requirements.title: Depth course and unit minima
requirements.summary: Both the depth course-count minimum and unit minimum must be met. The AI sheet's actual minima and choices remain unreviewed.

notes: Official bachelors overview confirms Artificial Intelligence as a formally declared CS track; the same section calls it an AI concentration. Classify as concentration within CS BS, never as a standalone AI degree.
No public syllabus or course-site verification was performed for this discovery.
General track/parent-relationship policies are now mapped. Local AI depth courses, alternatives, counts, units and footnotes remain unavailable; this policy-only requirement inventory is partial.

The official 2026–27 AI PDF viewer is public (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sVHp_i3gvWEo6qKm0GM8NLMWhgwAJyIb/view). Its exact embedded download URL is robots-disallowed. No alternate download or content bypass was attempted; the PDF contents were not inspected.

The 2026–27 Engineering handbook CS page supplies degree overview and suggested research preparation, not the complete AI track inventory. Suggested research courses were not mislabeled as track requirements.
Quarter calendar is evidenced by the program-sheet page explicitly describing academic quarter exceptions and graduation timing. No conversion of source units into semester credits is made.
Complete concentration scope would include the AI depth inventory and governing track policies, not a reconstruction of all bachelor general education requirements.
